I have a story to tell you all. One day, I was bored and decided I want to play some sussy amogus. So, I redownloaded the game and got ready to play an online game with toddlers. I noticed there was a login that I had to complete, so as a joke I set my age to 7. Unbeknownst to me at the time, this would be my downfall. When I gave these folks my location, birth certificate, ID, and relationship status, I moved onwards. However, I found that once I was in the game, I could only use preset phrases! I couldn't yell slurs in chat anymore, and I was very upset. So, I began the process of trying to change my age. Unfortunately, people don't age.
I tried everything in my power to change my age to that of someone who could die in open combat on the battlefield, but not drink alcohol. However, it was to no avail. I am certain that the developers were truly intelligent individuals, as I was unable to age myself up, reflecting reality.
So now I sit, and I wait. In 11 years time, I will be able to finally play Amongoose as I wished to on this day. As such, I regail you with my epic, and a warning:

Don't set your age to 7 as a joke.

I am very happy with play with and against human opponents in the game. The unique level of interaction between players resonates with me. The game determines if you are an impostor or crew mate so that is out of the players hands. The impostor tries to sabotage the map or kill the other players to win. The crew mates need to finish their tasks and live to win the game. It plays the players against each other within the map, so it is a fresh take on Player vs Player and has Player vs Environment elements in multiplayer games every time.

My wife poops in the shower and stomps it down the drain. Not a joke. She recently told me this and I've been living with it for weeks now. She even broke the news to me while laughing about it. "You know what a waffle stomp is?", she asked me as she laughed and laughed so hard she started crying! I feel disgusted and betrayed. I can't even look at her over breakfast anymore before I head off to work and while at work all I can do is wonder to myself, 'is she doing it right now?'. Apparently this has been going on for years! Says she uses all the scented candles she obsessively buys online to mask the smell. I work 12- 15 hour days so plenty of time to cover her ♥♥♥♥ stink. A few times we've had to snake the drain due to a clog. Now I know why. I'm not sure I can live this life anymore.
